# Implementation Plan: Inventory Item Variations & Per-Variation Stock

**Branch**: `001-variation-stock-tracking` | **Date**: 2026-05-16 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)  
**Input**: Feature specification at `specs/inventory-service/inventory-items/variation-stock-tracking/spec.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-plan`. Task breakdown: [tasks.md](./tasks.md) (`/speckit-tasks`).

## Summary

Extend **inventory-service** and **ui** to support multi-dimensional product
variations (size, color, material) with **per-variation, per-location** stock
balances, stock-in/stock-out, atomic transfers between locations, and
two-level reporting—while preserving legacy single-stock items on the existing
`inventory_items` model. Stock reservation workflows (`ReserveInventoryWorkflow`,
`CheckStockActivity`, etc.) gain optional `variation_id` and `location_id`
targets. Operator UI uses dedicated pages and inline forms (minimal modals per
UI-001/UI-002).

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: PHP 8.2+ (Laravel 11), TypeScript (React 18 via Vite)  
**Primary Dependencies**: laravel-workflow, spatie/laravel-model-states, Eloquent, React, Tailwind CSS  
**Storage**: MySQL (`inventory_db`) — new tables + migrations on `inventory_items`  
**Testing**: PHPUnit (`inventory-service/tests/Unit`), Vitest or React Testing Library for `ui/`  
**Target Platform**: Docker Compose microservices (inventory :8004, UI via gateway)  
**Project Type**: Monorepo web service + SPA  
**Performance Goals**: Variation generation for ≤50 combinations &lt;500ms; stock movement API p95 &lt;200ms on local compose  
**Constraints**: Backward compatible APIs; atomic transfers; no modal-first UI  
**Scale/Scope**: Catalog items with up to ~50 variations per item (per SC-005); admin-managed locations

**Structure Decision**: Backend owns stock truth in `inventory-service`. `ui/`
consumes REST JSON. Legacy items sync `inventory_items.quantity_*` from default
location balance (see [research.md](./research.md)).

## Complexity Tracking

| Violation | Why Needed | Simpler Alternative Rejected Because |
|-----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| Two modules (`inventory-service` + `ui`) | Spec mandates operator UI (FR-017, UI-001) | API-only fails warehouse operator acceptance |
| Dual stock representation for legacy items | Sales/reservation flows use `inventory_items` columns | Breaking columns regresses ReserveInventoryWorkflow |
